test_case_title: English/Hinglish: Unauthorized ₹28,500 UPI Debit Reported Within 24 Hours
raw_user_input: Yesterday night ₹28500 was debited from my bank account via two unauthorized UPI transactions without me sharing any OTP or PIN. I immediately blocked my account and emailed the bank within 12 hours with the UTR numbers, but the branch manager says I am liable and nothing can be done for 90 days.

evidence_checklist.how_to_obtain_or_create: Note the exact 12-digit UPI RRN/UTR number and timestamp.
Call 1930 immediately if fraud occurred so the recipient bank account layer is frozen.

evidence_checklist.how_to_obtain_or_create: Send email within 3 working days to lock in RBI Zero-Liability protection.

structured_case_analysis.pre_notice_evidence_trap_tip: Call 1930 within the 'Golden Hour' so the National Cybercrime Portal places an automated lien/freeze on the fraudster's bank account before the money is withdrawn at an ATM. Simultaneously email your bank citing RBI Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18 demanding a shadow credit within 10 working days.
structured_case_analysis.plain_language_standing_en: Under Paragraphs 6, 7 & 9 of the RBI Master Circular on Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions, if you report an unauthorized third-party breach within 3 working days, your liability is ZERO and the bank must credit a shadow reversal of ₹28,500 within 10 working days. For failed UPI debits not auto-reversed in T+1/T+5 days, the bank owes you ₹100/day automatic compensation.
structured_case_analysis.plain_language_standing_hi: RBI Circular ke Paragraphs 6, 7 aur 9 ke tahat, 3 working days ke andar unauthorized transaction report karne par aapki Zero Liability hoti hai aur bank ko 10 working days mein ₹28,500 ka shadow reversal dena zaroori hai.

verified_statutes.act: RBI Master Circular on Customer Protection — Limiting Liability in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
verified_statutes.summary: Customer has ZERO liability where unauthorized transaction occurs due to contributory fraud/negligence or third-party breach if notified within 3 working days. Bank must credit shadow reversal within 10 working days.
verified_statutes.plain_hindi: Agar bina aapki galti ke bank/UPI se paisa kata hai aur aap 3 working days mein bank ko report kar dete hain, toh RBI niyam ke mutabik aapki Zero Liability hai aur bank ko 10 din mein shadow refund dena hoga.

verified_statutes.act: RBI Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and Customer Compensation for Failed Transactions
verified_statutes.summary: If a UPI transaction fails and money is debited from the sender's account, the bank must auto-reverse it within T+1 day (or T+5 for merchant transactions), failing which the bank must pay ₹100 per day automatic penalty to the customer.
verified_statutes.plain_hindi: Failed UPI transaction ka paisa T+1 se T+5 din mein wapas na aane par bank ko customer ko ₹100 prati din ka automatic muavza (penalty) dena padta hai.

verified_statutes.summary: If a bank or payment app fails to resolve a written complaint within 30 days (or rejects it unfairly), the customer can file a free complaint on cms.rbi.org.in for an award up to ₹20 Lakh plus ₹1 Lakh for mental agony.
verified_statutes.plain_hindi: Bank dwara 30 din mein sunvayi na karne par aap cms.rbi.org.in par muft RBI Ombudsman complaint kar sakte hain.

verified_statutes.section: Paragraph 6 & Recovery Agent Fair Practices Code
verified_statutes.summary: Digital lending apps cannot access mobile phone contacts, call logs, or photo galleries, and recovery agents are strictly prohibited from calling before 8:00 AM or after 7:00 PM or harassing family/contacts.
verified_statutes.plain_hindi: Loan app wale aapke phone contacts/photos access nahi kar sakte aur subah 8 baje se pehle ya shaam 7 baje ke baad call karke dhamka nahi sakte.

generated_action_kit.formal_legal_notice_md:
# REGISTERED A.D. / EMAIL — LEGAL DEMAND NOTICE
**WITHOUT PREJUDICE**  
**Strategy Posture:** grounded-statute-engine-v1 (Balanced Legal Strategy)

**Date:** 11 November 2026  
**From:** Aarav Verma (Test Claimant), residing at Flat 402, Indiranagar, Bengaluru - 560038  
**To:** Opposite Party / Respondent, having address at Registered Address of Opposite Party  

**SUBJECT: FINAL PRE-LITIGATION LEGAL NOTICE FOR RECOVERY OF ₹28,500 AND STATUTORY COMPLIANCE (UNAUTHORIZED UPI / BANK DEBIT, FAILED TRANSACTION HOLD & DIGITAL LENDING HARASSMENT)**

Sir / Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my self-represented claim, I hereby serve upon you the following categorical Legal Demand Notice:

### 1. CHRONOLOGICAL STATEMENT OF FACTS
1. ₹28,500 debited via UPI/Bank or harassed by digital lending agent. (*Triggers RBI Master Circular on Customer Protection (Ref: DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18).*)
2. Report to 1930 Cybercrime Helpline & Bank within 3 working days. (*Locks in ZERO Customer Liability and 10-day shadow reversal mandate under Paragraphs 6 & 9 of RBI Circular.*)
3. If bank delays beyond TAT / 30 days, escalate to cms.rbi.org.in.

### 2. APPLICABLE STATUTORY PROVISIONS (VERIFIED INDIAN LAW)
Your continued failure and refusal to discharge the lawful liability of **₹28,500** is in direct breach of the following statutory provisions:
- **RBI Master Circular on Customer Protection — Limiting Liability in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (Paragraphs 6, 7 & 9 (Ref: DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18)):** Customer has ZERO liability where unauthorized transaction occurs due to contributory fraud/negligence or third-party breach if notified within 3 working days. Bank must credit shadow reversal within 10 working days.
- **RBI Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and Customer Compensation for Failed Transactions (Circular DPSS.CO.PD No.629/02.01.014/2019-20):** If a UPI transaction fails and money is debited from the sender's account, the bank must auto-reverse it within T+1 day (or T+5 for merchant transactions), failing which the bank must pay ₹100 per day automatic penalty to the customer.
- **Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (RB-IOS) (Clause 10 & Clause 15):** If a bank or payment app fails to resolve a written complaint within 30 days (or rejects it unfairly), the customer can file a free complaint on cms.rbi.org.in for an award up to ₹20 Lakh plus ₹1 Lakh for mental agony.
- **RBI Guidelines on Digital Lending, 2022 (Paragraph 6 & Recovery Agent Fair Practices Code):** Digital lending apps cannot access mobile phone contacts, call logs, or photo galleries, and recovery agents are strictly prohibited from calling before 8:00 AM or after 7:00 PM or harassing family/contacts.

### 3. FINAL DEMAND & CONSEQUENCE OF NON-COMPLIANCE
I hereby call upon you to:
1. Remit the principal sum of **₹28,500** (Rupees 28,500 only) along with accrued interest @ 18% per annum immediately via NEFT/IMPS/UPI; and
2. Issue written confirmation of compliance within **7 (seven) days** from the receipt of this Notice.

Take notice that should you fail to comply within the stipulated **7 (seven) days**, I shall immediately file a formal recovery petition before **https://cybercrime.gov.in (Call 1930 immediately) & https://cms.rbi.org.in (RBI Complaint Management System)** entirely at your risk as to costs, statutory interest, and damages.

A copy of this Notice is retained in my records for production before the competent Court/Authority as Annexures.

Yours faithfully,

**Aarav Verma (Test Claimant)**  
*(Claimant)*
